column1: # Cases for refuse-stop-while-away.sh — one per line, tab-separated:
#   name  stretch  refusals  stop_hook_active  shells  fixture  want  refusals_after
# stretch:   open | none | closed | expired     (state the runner writes with scripts/away-obligation)
# refusals:  refusals already made in the stretch
# shells:    none | shell | monitor | orphan | fail   (what the stubbed shell lister prints; fail = exits 1)
# fixture:   a transcript in hooks/tests/fixtures/away/ (without .jsonl), or `unreadable` for a missing file
# want:      allow (no output) | block (decision block) | allow+notify (no output, notify ran)
# refusals_after: the refusal count in the state file after the hook ran (- = no state file)
no stretch is never refused
closed stretch is never refused
expired stretch is never refused
open, nothing armed, is refused
second refusal still blocks
third attempt is let through and notified
stop_hook_active is let through
live background shell arms
monitor block in the lister does not arm
orphan block in the lister does not arm
standing wakeup arms
wakeup that already fired does not arm
wakeup fired then re-armed arms
wakeup cancelled with stop does not arm
recurring cron arms
wakeup from before the user's last prompt does not arm
task notification does not end the wakeup's standing
a Monitor call does not arm
lister failure fails open
unreadable transcript fails open
